items.tldr: GeForce NOWに新たに「Empulse」や「Dark Scrolls」などのゲームが追加され、Steamの夏のセールが始まる。

items.title: AI and Liability
items.description: Earlier this month, a German court ruled that Google is liable for its AI search summaries. Rejecting defenses like “users can check for themselves,” and that they generally know “that information generated with AI should not be blindly trusted,” the court held that the AI&#8

items.title: The Four Elevations of Effective Fraud Prevention
items.description: Fraudsters don't attack just one transaction. They target accounts, platforms, and entire ecosystems. IPQS explains the four elevations of fraud prevention and why broader visibility improves fraud detection. [...]

items.tldr: 今週のThreatsDay Bulletinでは、スマートTVのプロキシウェア、24年続くcurlのバグ、AI犯罪フォーラムなど、サイバーセキュリティに関する複数の脅威が報告されています。

items.title: Webinar: Why account takeovers remain one of the hardest threats to stop

items.title: Interesting Paper Exploring Prompt Injection
items.description: This is a fascinating explotation of how LLMs fall for prompt injection attacks. It turns out that they learn to recognize the style of text in different role/instruction blocks, and not just the tags. Their conclusion: Role tags were a formatting trick that became the security architecture and the
items.tldr: TL;DR: LLMはプロンプトインジェクション攻撃に対して脆弱であり、役割タグがセキュリティアーキテクチャとして機能することが明らかになった。

items.title: Surviving the Mythos Era: Richard Bejtlich on the Case for NDR
items.description: Despite the abundance of telemetry at analysts’ disposal, many security operations teams struggle to answer a few basic questions during incident investigation: What happened? What evidence do we have? How do we know we’re seeing it all, in context? Answering these questions requires teams to go bey
items.tldr: TL;DR: セキュリティオペレーションチームは、インシデント調査中に基本的な質問に答えるのに苦労しており、NDR（Network Detection and Response）の重要性が強調されている。
